dod_intent_evidence: Genuine DoD motion (Naval Postgraduate School CRUSER collaboration, infiniTE float built for 'naval situational awareness'), but they've crossed the valley: a $30.8M Department of War APFIT award (July 2026) explicitly to 'Accelerate Persistent Undersea Monitoring Capabilities,' with CEO quoted 'we're delivering PSAP systems immediately to warfighters to meet their requirements' — production/fielding acceleration funding, not a stuck prototype.
what_they_do: Builds thermal-powered (ocean-temperature energy harvesting) subsea profiling floats/drones for persistent ocean monitoring; just won a $30.8M APFIT award to accelerate fielding for the Navy.
